publishers.NISR: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda

principles: DAMA-inspired metadata, quality, stewardship, lineage and lifecycle management

metadata_registry.title: Publisher title
metadata_registry.publication_date: ISO date; imputed day identified in usage_notes
metadata_registry.section: First extracted line of PDF page; heuristic, not authoritative heading

quality_rules.rule: Required publisher, title, date, source URL and usage notes
HTTPS allowlisted official hosts, no redirects
More than 30% pages under 40 characters or under 200 total characters

lifecycle: Keep versioned reports when source bytes change; no automatic deletion. Maintainer handles lawful removal and backups.
privacy: No customer records. API questions are not persisted. Streamlit conversation is session-only.
restrictions: Research demonstration only. No transactions, personalized investment instructions or consequential decisions.
governance_record_store: PostgreSQL/SQLite governance_records with SHA256 payload identity; explicit updates archive previous versions.
stewardship: BNR candidate reports remain outside the indexed corpus pending rights clarification. NISR date precision/proxies are explicitly documented per report.
